# laravelforge_scheduled_job (Data Source)

Fetches a single Laravel Forge scheduled job (cron job) by ID on a server.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (Number) Numeric ID of the scheduled job.
- `organization` (String) Organization slug.
- `server_id` (Number) Numeric ID of the server the job runs on.

### Read-Only

- `command` (String) Command the job executes.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp.
- `cron` (String) Cron expression for the job.
- `frequency` (String) How often the job runs (e.g. `Minutely`, `Nightly`, `Custom`).
- `name` (String) Job name (may be null).
- `next_run_time` (String) Timestamp of the next scheduled run.
- `status` (String) Provisioning status (e.g. `installing`, `installed`).
- `updated_at` (String) Last-update timestamp.
- `user` (String) System user the command runs as.
